connectorUiConfig.title: Armis Alerts (Serverless)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
The [Armis](https://www.armis.com/) Alerts connector provides the capability to ingest Armis security alerts into Microsoft Sentinel through the Armis REST API. This serverless connector uses the Codeless Connector Platform (CCF) to poll the Armis API and ingest alert data. Refer to the API documentation: `https://<YourArmisInstance>.armis.com/api/v1/docs` for more information.

**Note:** This connector ingests Alerts only. For Activities data, use the legacy Azure Function-based connector or contact Armis support for guidance.

sampleQueries.query:
ArmisAlerts_CL
 | where Severity in ('High', 'Critical')
 | sort by TimeGenerated desc

ArmisAlerts_CL
 | summarize Count=count() by Severity
 | sort by Count desc

dataTypes.name: ArmisAlerts_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
ArmisAlerts_CL
 | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
 | where isnotempty(Time)

customs.name: Armis API Access Token
customs.description:
An Armis API access token is required. Follow these steps to obtain it:
1. Log into your Armis instance
2. Navigate to Settings -> API Management
3. Create or retrieve your API secret key
4. Use the secret key to generate an access token via the API endpoint: `POST https://<YourArmisInstance>.armis.com/api/v1/access_token/` with the secret key in the request body
5. The access token is valid for 30 days and must be manually refreshed

Refer to the Armis API documentation at `https://<YourArmisInstance>.armis.com/api/v1/docs` for more details.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Obtain Armis API Access Token
instructionSteps.description:
Follow these instructions to generate an Armis API access token:

1. Log into your Armis instance
2. Navigate to **Settings** -> **API Management**
3. If the secret key has not been created, click **Create** to generate it
4. Click **Show** to view the secret key
5. Use the secret key to generate an access token:

```bash
curl -X POST https://<YourArmisInstance>.armis.com/api/v1/access_token/ \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"secret_key": "<your-secret-key>"}'
```

6. Copy the `access_token` value from the response
7. **Important:** Access tokens expire after 30 days and must be manually refreshed

instructionSteps.title: 2. Configure Armis Alerts Data Connector
instructionSteps.description: Provide the required configuration parameters to connect to the Armis API.

parameters.label: Armis Access Token
parameters.placeholder: Enter your Armis API access token
parameters.name: ArmisAccessToken

instructionSteps.title: 3. Important Notes
instructionSteps.description:
**Token Expiration:** Armis access tokens expire after 30 days. You will need to:
- Generate a new access token using your secret key
- Update the connector configuration with the new token
- Reconnect the data connector

**Data Limitations:** This connector ingests Alerts only. For Activities data, use the legacy Azure Function-based connector (ArmisAlertsActivities).

**Severity Filtering:** Specify comma-separated severity levels (e.g., `High,Critical` or `Low,Medium,High,Critical`). Leave blank to ingest all severities.
